tests.name: 20 000 roots, 20 000 words
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(648)
letters = 'abcdefghij'
roots = list({''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(5, 9))) for _ in range(20000)})
sentence = ' '.join(''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(1, 12))) for _ in range(20000))
tests.expr: (len(out), out[:120], sum(i * len(w) for i, w in enumerate(out.split())))
tests.expected: (147570, 'ddgebbbjhfa ejchbhgf cdj djghbfjd igdddf hgdafgcbf caijacchbcdj eai behh behecbb cda acdjd bihaigchceca highcahbbiac g d', 1273161753)
tests.hint: Checking every root against every word is too slow. Walk a trie of roots instead.
